# `network/realm/link/ContinuityStore.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/realm/link/ContinuityStore.js`

Storage-agnostic continuity records for reconnect and verified transfer resume. Raw reconnect tokens are deliberately rejected: callers persist an opaque credential only after sealing it with the OS/profile storage layer.

### `continuityStorageKey({ realmId, branchId, linkId })`

### `createMemoryContinuityAdapter()`

In-memory adapter for tests and ephemeral sessions; durable OS storage is injected with the same interface.

### `updateTransferProgress(record, update, now = Date.now()`

Update one transfer monotonically; completed/cancelled records cannot be reopened.
